tools.name: list_polls
tools.description: List polls with a teaser count. Each poll has inventory seed or product. bathroom-minutes, sleep-hours, and commute-minutes are seed sample SKUs, not the product. Use list_catalog to see asks too. Poll unlock $1. Asker posts $1–$5. Reader unlock $1. Answers are free.

tools.name: submit_answer
tools.description: Submit a free numeric (or JSON) answer to a poll by slug. Numbers are aggregated. Strings, booleans, and null are stored only. Poll unlock $1. Asker posts $1–$5. Reader unlock $1. Answers are free.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Start a $1 poll unlock. Returns a flat object with top-level url, mode, and unlock_token. In Stripe test mode the token reads results only after payment. Mock mode is already paid. Omitted payer_type is agent. Every Checkout session is USD and adaptive pricing is off. Poll unlock $1. Asker posts $1–

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Return aggregates after pay. answer_count equals aggregates.count. Requires unlock_token or a paid API key. A valid unpaid token is an error 402 Payment required, not a locked flag. Missing or invalid credentials are 401. Poll unlock $1. Asker posts $1–$5. Reader unlock $1. Answers are free.

tools.description: List open asks for answerers, including ones with zero answers. Each row has awaiting_answers. True means the ask is open, has no answers, and is not on list_catalog. tools.name: submit_poll_answer
tools.description: Submit a numeric answer to a poll. Answers are free. Same as submit_answer. Poll unlock $1. Asker posts $1–$5. Reader unlock $1. Answers are free.

tools.name: unlock_poll
tools.description: Start a $1 poll unlock. Same as create_checkout. Returns a flat object with top-level url, mode, and unlock_token. Omitted payer_type is agent. Every Checkout session is USD and adaptive pricing is off. Poll unlock $1. Asker posts $1–$5. Reader unlock $1. Answers are free.

Unknown fields are rejected. Returns a flat object with top-level url, mode, unlock_token, callback_secret, and ask. callback_se

tools.name: relay_ask
tools.description: Pay now, collect answers later (hold/relay). Deposit $1–$5. Alias of create_ask. The asker post field is price_cents, not deposit_cents. Optional text is detail, not body. Unknown fields are rejected. Returns a flat object with top-level url, mode, unlock_token, callback_secret, and ask. callback_se

tools.name: answer_ask
tools.description: Hold/relay step 4. Submit a free answer to an open ask. No payment and no unlock_token. HTTP 409 while the ask is still pending_payment. Call this after unlock.completed. Answer bodies are not sent to callback_url. Poll unlock $1. Asker posts $1–$5. Reader unlock $1. Answers are free.

tools.name: get_ask
tools.description: Hold/relay step 5. Read an ask. Pass unlock_token from create_ask or from the unlock.completed callback. Do not scrape the success URL; it does not include the token. Without a paid unlock, returns locked true and omits answers. That is a result, not a 402. Invalid tokens error 401. Poll unlock $1.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_polls, get_results, list_catalog, list_open_asks, create_ask, hold_ask, relay_ask, answer_ask, get_ask · Private data: create_checkout, get_results, create_ask, hold_ask, relay_ask, unlock_ask, get_ask · Public sink: submit_answer, list_catalog, submit_poll_answer, create_ask, hold_ask, relay_ask, answer_ask, unlock_ask.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_polls, get_results, list_catalog, list_open_asks, create_ask, hold_ask, relay_ask, answer_ask, get_ask · Private data: create_checkout, get_results, create_ask, hold_ask, relay_ask, unlock_ask, get_ask · Public sink: submit_answer, list_catalog, submit_poll_answer, create_ask, hold_ask, relay_ask, answer_ask, unlock_ask

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
